newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KOMERCNI BANKA SAYS CUTS REF RATE TO 14.6PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KOMERCNI BANKA SAYS CUTS REF RATE TO 14.6PCT.

text.p: The largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s. said on Friday it would cut its reference rate to 14.6 percent from 15.35 percent and its base rate to 13.5 percent from 13.7 percent on Monday, August 11.
"The cutting of rates corresponds to the movement of rates on the interbank deposit market," Komercni said in a statement.
Interbank rates have been falling steadily in recent weeks. The central bank left its two week repo rate unchanged on Friday at 14.5 percent.
